title: Membership Brand System
description: A four-image reference-dependent system that locks one gym brand language across hero posters, membership promotion, murals, and challenge-week assets.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the gym brand palette, spatial identity, member-facing poster grammar, and premium club energy. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while adapting the same system to tier promotion, wall graphics, and challenge-week surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-membership-tier-poster, 03-wall-mural-visual, 04-challenge-week-variant. Queue may run 02-membership-tier-poster, 03-wall-mural-visual, 04-challenge-week-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
